model: 2D frame-direction (model X) concentrated-plasticity model with IMKPeakOriented hinges

inner.//: Stories 1-7: each inner line carries half of the Y-direction wall (one C3 boundary + half the web) bending about its weak axis. Stories 8-10: C3 line columns.

transverse_reinforcement.source: 実験結果の報告.pdf Table 1 (column hoops, index = story 1..10 = 1F..10F columns) and Table 2 (beam stirrups, index = story 1..10 = 2F..RF beams).
transverse_reinforcement.leg_interpretation: Hoop label [a,b]: a is taken as the legs parallel to drawing Y (= model X, frame direction). Basis: C3 (long side along drawing X) and the C2 sub-ties are drawn parallel to drawing Y and carry the larger count. Interpretation, not stated in the table.

hinges.equations: Haselton et al. (2016) ACI SJ 113(6) / PEER 2007/03 empirical RC column equations; applied to beams with nu = 0 and to wall weak-axis piers without separate calibration.
hinges.//stiffness_basis: Default EIstf40 (secant at 40% My, Haselton initial stiffness for dynamic analysis): T1 = 0.829 s vs measured 0.85 s; EIy gives 1.080 s. EIy = secant to yield, Haselton eq. EIy/EIg = -0.07 + 0.59 nu + 0.07 Ls/H, bounded 0.2-0.6; EIstf40 = -0.02 + 0.98 nu + 0.09 Ls/H, bounded 0.35-0.8. stiffness_scale multiplies the chosen basis for period calibration.
hinges.//residual: Residual strength and ultimate rotation are not given by Haselton; assumed.

joint: rigid panel (stiff elastic links from joint centre to member faces); no shear or bond-slip flexibility

analysis.damping_note: Same 5% Rayleigh assumption as the 3D model (anchored at T1 and 0.2 T1). Mass term on floor nodes; stiffness term on elastic members only, scaled (n+1)/n (Zareian & Medina 2010). Hinges and rigid links undamped.
